repairs.name: Safe owner shutdown and evidence preservation
repairs.detail: Preserve journals and logs first; request a cooperative stop, then bound graceful waits and signal only authenticated owner and registered frontend identities. Release only verified-dead owner leases. Forced recovery can produce a diagnostic return; an old owner terminal return is not promised.
